purpose: Teach: 部首/肉食/賢者/胃腸/貧富/剰余/分娩/既知

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、書類管理を部首順で整理しろ
lines.en: Documents should be organized by radical order in this company.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Speaks from behind the desk. No room for negotiation. Matter-of-fact delivery, eyes forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員食堂の肉食メニューを見直します
lines.en: Understood. I'll review the cafeteria meat options.
lines.style: Respectful, controlled. Rapid note-taking tempo. Clear confirmation—he's already mentally pivoting to the next task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界の賢者から学べ
lines.en: This company learns from industry leaders.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate. Slight pause between clauses. Not a suggestion—a principle being stated for the record.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の胃腸ケアを健康施策に加えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll add digestive health care to our benefits package.
lines.style: Focused, professional. Steady cadence. Writing mentally—translating the directive into action steps as he speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の貧富に応じた福利厚生にはするな
lines.en: Don't create tiered benefits based on salary. Everyone gets the same.
lines.style: Firm, no softening. Slight edge—this is principle, not preference. Holds eye contact on the negative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。剰余金の活用を再検討します
lines.en: Understood. I'll reconsider how we allocate surplus funds.
lines.style: Immediate assent. Brisk tempo. The rhythm of someone who has learned exactly how this man speaks and matches it back.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の分娩休暇を充実させろ
lines.en: Strengthen maternity leave in this company. Make it robust.
lines.style: Direct, unhurried. Weight on the word 'robust'—this matters. Not asking permission, setting policy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。既知のリスクは事前に共有します
lines.en: Understood. I'll flag any known risks and share them ahead of time.
lines.style: Concluding tone. Slight breath before speaking—the signal that this is the final confirmation. Respectful closure.
